column2: Both chapters share one derivation rule
column3: They do not. A web angle is a CATALOGUE section cut to length (L90x9, L=135/210, section fixed). A shear plate is a section INVENTED per joint at a fixed 70 mm stick-out (L=70, W=135/210). That difference is exactly why the shear plate can miss stock and the angle cannot. B.20 audit.
